prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production transparent outfit photography contact sheet for an interactive fashion fitting studio.

Create ONE high-resolution PORTRAIT PNG image, ideally 1536 x 2304 pixels or the highest supported portrait resolution, containing EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS: nine equal invisible portrait tiles in a perfect 3x3 grid. Each tile is one COMPLETE seamless photograph of the SAME adult South Asian male fashion model Arin seen in the reference image. Image 1 is an IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: preserve his face, short wavy black hair, warm medium brown natural skin, lean athletic masculine physique and adult age. Do not copy the reference layout or backdrop.

ALL NINE looks wear the SAME LIGHT NEUTRAL GREY REGULAR-FIT CREWNECK COTTON T-SHIRT: no chest pocket, circular ribbed crew collar, short sleeves, natural cotton knit, realistic drape, shoulder seams, sleeve hems and fabric folds. Shirt hem is naturally tucked into the trousers in every photo. This is an ESSENTIAL CREW TEE, never a V-neck, polo, collar shirt or boxy pocket tee.

The TROUSER depends strictly on ROW:
TOP ROW (all three cells): neutral medium grey slim stretch chinos, tapered male leg, realistic fly, pockets and belt loops.
MIDDLE ROW (all three cells): neutral medium grey wide relaxed pleated tailored trousers, visibly wider silhouette, front pleats and pressed crease.
BOTTOM ROW (all three cells): neutral medium grey straight selvedge denim jeans, five-pocket construction, visible denim weave and contrast stitching.

The FOOTWEAR depends strictly on COLUMN:
LEFT COLUMN (all three rows): clean WHITE leather low-top sneakers with white laces and rubber cupsole.
CENTER COLUMN (all three rows): neutral grey polished leather PENNY LOAFERS with visible penny strap, no laces.
RIGHT COLUMN (all three rows): neutral grey suede CHELSEA ANKLE BOOTS with elastic side gussets.

Every tile shows the FULL standing person, from complete hairstyle through both shoe soles. Each model is centered within its own equal tile. IDENTICAL straight front-facing relaxed catalog pose, arms naturally down with a small gap from the sides, five believable fingers visible, both feet flat and fully visible, feet shoulder-width apart. Exactly nine models, never more or fewer. Lock camera, identity, pose, lighting and scale across all nine photographs; vary only the designated pants and footwear. Each tile has at least TEN PERCENT vertical safety margin above the hair and below the soles, and generous horizontal space around hands. Never crop hair, hands, trouser hems or shoes. Never let a person cross a cell boundary.

TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with real alpha outside each complete person; no studio backdrop, no gradients, no ground, no rectangular backgrounds, no checkerboard painted into the image. Soft neutral photographic fashion lighting with lifelike skin pores, real fabric fibers, realistic continuous proportions and coherent clothing contact shadows. These must look like nine real single-exposure complete outfit photographs, NOT stitched body parts or separate garment overlays. No visible grid lines, no labels, no logos, no text, no borders, no watermark, no accessories. Keep all clothing chromatically NEUTRAL GREY / WHITE for later recoloring; keep warm natural skin and black hair unchanged.
